sub_areas.name: Old Oakville
sub_areas.note: Downtown, on the Lake Ontario shore between Sixteen Mile Creek/Oakville Harbour and Chartwell Road, north to Cornwall Road (Wikipedia). OGS point query at the Lakeshore Road area returns coarse glaciolacustrine sand and gravel over Georgian Bay Formation shale.

sub_areas.name: Kerr Village
sub_areas.note: Just west of the Old Village around Kerr Street between Speers Road and Lakeshore Road (Wikipedia); a Livable Oakville growth area (Town page). OGS point query returns clay-to-silt till over Queenston Formation.

sub_areas.name: Bronte
sub_areas.note: Southwest Oakville, centred on Bronte Harbour (Wikipedia); 'Bronte Village' is a Livable Oakville growth area (Town page). OGS point query returns coarse glaciolacustrine sand and gravel over Queenston Formation; Queenston red shale outcrops at Bronte Creek just south of the QEW (Wikipedia).

sub_areas.name: Glen Abbey
sub_areas.note: West Oakville along Third Line and Dorval Drive, west of Glen Abbey Golf Course (Wikipedia; Town 'Glen Abbey Information' page). OGS point query returns clay-to-silt till over Queenston Formation.

sub_areas.name: River Oaks
sub_areas.note: North-central Oakville, includes the Oak Park development (Wikipedia). OGS point query returns clay-to-silt till over Queenston Formation.

sub_areas.name: Joshua Creek
sub_areas.note: Named on the Town's Neighbourhood Information Map list (ARGO and Mattamy 'Joshua Creek' subdivisions) and after Joshua's Creek (Town creeks page). OGS point query in this area returns coarse glaciolacustrine sand and gravel over Georgian Bay Formation.

sub_areas.name: Eastlake (Morrison / Ford)
sub_areas.note: Southeast Oakville on the lakeshore, Chartwell Road east to the Mississauga border (Wikipedia). OGS bedrock query returns Georgian Bay Formation; no surficial polygon returned at the query point.

sub_areas.name: Clearview
sub_areas.note: Centre-east Oakville on the Mississauga border (Wikipedia). OGS point query returns Paleozoic bedrock at/near surface over Georgian Bay Formation.

sub_areas.name: College Park
sub_areas.note: Between Sixteen Mile Creek and just east of Trafalgar Road, QEW to Upper Middle Road, around Sheridan College (Wikipedia). OGS point query returns clay-to-silt till over Queenston Formation.

sub_areas.name: Iroquois Ridge North
sub_areas.note: Northeast Oakville between Upper Middle Road and Dundas Street (Wikipedia). OGS point query returns Paleozoic bedrock at/near surface over Georgian Bay Formation.

sub_areas.name: Iroquois Ridge South (Falgarwood)
sub_areas.note: Northeast Oakville; Falgarwood is at its southern end (Wikipedia).

sub_areas.name: Palermo
sub_areas.note: Northwest Oakville around Dundas Street and Bronte Road (Wikipedia). OGS point query returns clay-to-silt till over Queenston Formation.

sub_areas.name: Uptown Core
sub_areas.note: Either side of Trafalgar Road between Dundas Street and Glenashton Drive (Wikipedia). OGS point query returns clay-to-silt till over Queenston Formation.

surficial.description: Clay to silt-textured till (derived from glaciolacustrine deposits or shale). Commonly called Halton Till in regional literature, but that name is not carried in the OGS layer attributes and was not verified here.
surficial.where: Most of Oakville inland of the lakeshore band: query points at Kerr Village, College Park, Glen Abbey, River Oaks, Uptown Core, Palermo, Town Hall (1225 Trafalgar Rd) and north Oakville near Dundas St all return unit 5d.

surficial.unit: OGS MRD128-REV unit 9 - Coarse-textured glaciolacustrine deposits
surficial.description: Sand, gravel, minor silt and clay (former glacial Lake Iroquois nearshore deposits).
surficial.where: Lakeshore band: query points at Old Oakville (Lakeshore Rd), Bronte and Joshua Creek return unit 9.

surficial.description: Bedrock at or near surface (drift too thin to map).
surficial.where: Creek valleys and the east side: query points in the Sixteen Mile Creek valley at the town-centre coordinate (43.45011, -79.68292), Bronte Creek at the QEW, Clearview and Iroquois Ridge North return unit 3.

surficial.unit: OGS MRD128-REV unit 19 - Modern alluvial deposits
surficial.description: Clay, silt, sand, gravel, may contain organic remains.
surficial.where: Sixteen Mile Creek mouth / harbour flats (query point 43.442, -79.669).

surficial.description: End moraine formed primarily of silty, clay-rich sand, underpinned by shale bedrock; hinders water absorption (Wikipedia).
surficial.where: Straddles Oakville and Milton; about 20 km long, 30 m high and 4 km wide, extending from the Niagara Escarpment north of Nelson toward Streetsville (Wikipedia).

bedrock.formation: Queenston Formation (west and central Oakville) and Georgian Bay Formation (east Oakville); both Upper Ordovician shale-dominated units (OGS MRD219).
bedrock.description: Queenston: red shale and siltstone, minor green shale and siltstone, and variable calcareous siltstone to sandstone and limestone interbeds. Georgian Bay: interbedded grey-green to dark grey shale and fossiliferous calcareous siltstone to bioclastic limestone. OGS point queries return Queenston at Bronte, Kerr Village, College Park, Town Hall, Glen Abbey, Palermo, Uptown Core and north Oakville, and Georgian Bay at Old Oakville lakeshore, Eastlake, Clearview, Joshua Creek and the town-centre coordinate; the contact runs roughly north-south through central Oakville near Sixteen Mile Creek.
bedrock.depth_note: Depth to bedrock was not retrieved (no drift-thickness dataset queried). OGS surficial mapping shows bedrock at or near surface (unit 3) in the Sixteen Mile Creek and Bronte Creek valleys and at the Clearview and Iroquois Ridge North query points; Wikipedia records a Queenston outcrop at Bronte Creek just south of the QEW. Elsewhere bedrock lies beneath till or glaciolacustrine sand of unstated thickness.

implications_for_piles: The Town of Oakville's own deck permit sample drawings require, for steel helical piers/piles, that manufacturer's information and CCMC approval be submitted with the permit application and that a professional engineer determine depth, spacing and size based on soil condition.

The same Town drawings set the conventional baseline any pile design is compared against: footings a minimum of 4'-0" below grade on undisturbed soil, sized on an assumed soil bearing capacity of 2,000 lbs/ft2; any footing within 4'-0" of the house foundation must extend down to the level of the existing foundation.

Soil texture differs by neighbourhood: OGS maps clay-to-silt till (unit 5d) across inland Oakville and coarse sand and gravel (unit 9) along the lakeshore (Old Oakville, Bronte, Joshua Creek); the engineer's soil-specific determination the Town requires is therefore not transferable between these areas.

OGS maps bedrock at or near surface (unit 3) in the Sixteen Mile Creek and Bronte Creek valleys and at the Clearview and Iroquois Ridge North query points, over Queenston or Georgian Bay shale; shallow shale is a site condition to confirm before installation in those areas. No site-specific depth, torque or capacity figures were retrieved.

permits.authority: Town of Oakville Building Services (the Town's permit pages also refer to 'Building Department' staff)
permits.deck_permit_required_when: Decks greater than 10 square metres in area and higher than 61 centimetres above the adjacent grade require a building permit; any size deck attached to a house requires a building permit. The application-process page lists 'Deck greater than 0.61 metres (two feet) in height and is attached to a building' under projects requiring a permit, and 'Deck less than 0.61 mm [sic] (two feet) in height and not attached to a building' under projects that do not.
permits.footing_depth_requirement: Town deck sample drawings: 'MIN. 4'-0" BELOW GRADE ON UNDISTURBED SOIL'; any deck footing (excluding deck blocks) within 4'-0" of the house foundation must extend down to the level of the existing foundation; footing/pier sizing table assumes a soil bearing capacity of 2,000 lbs/ft2. Steel helical pier/pile: manufacturer's information must be submitted with the permit application along with CCMC approval, and a professional engineer must determine the depth, spacing and size based on soil condition.
inspections: Pre-backfill (site survey including top of foundation elevation for new construction)
Final interior and exterior safety (prior to occupancy)
Final exterior (to be completed within six months)
permits.fee_note: 2026 Building Services Rates and Fees: Deck (each) $220.00, unchanged 2024-2026, effective date shown as Mar-23; minimum fee for a building permit $200; a $100 non-refundable pre-screening fee is charged at online submission and credited toward the permit.
permits.timeline_note: Town states applications are subject to the Large Municipalities Chief Building Officers (LMCBO) development application process timelines and that review times vary with volume, complexity, staffing and resubmissions; no fixed day-count is published on the page. Inspection requests submitted online before 6 p.m. are booked for the next business day; inspections run 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., Monday to Friday.
permits.portal_note: Building Services permit applications are submitted through the Town's 'Online Services' account (sign-in hosted at oakvillecrm.my.site.com); the linked Town page is the public entry point.
